title: Proclamation No. 732, s. 2014
text:
MALACAÑAN PALACE MANILA

PROCLAMATION NO. 732

DECLARING FRIDAY, 14 MARCH 2014, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE CITY OF PASSI, PROVINCE OF ILOILO

WHEREAS , Friday, 14 March 2014 marks the Foundation Day anniversary of the City of Passi, Iloilo;

WHEREAS , it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Passi, Iloilo be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. , Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III , do hereby declare Friday, 14 March 2014, as a special (non-working) day in the City of Passi, Province of Iloilo.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF , I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Fourteen.

By authority of the President:

(Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR. Executive Secretary
